row.notes: Gets the player vehicle (Sess_Get_PlayerVehicleIndex on +0x668), its tyre component and tyre-set inventory at component+0x9c68. Returns 1 when the index is out of range (count inventory+0xd8), there is no free set in the 0x28-stride slot (set size 0x6c) or Car_Tyre_IsCompoundAllowed fails; otherwise 0, or 2 when the index is not the selected one (vm+0x6250) and the dry group (indices 0-2) differs from the group of the selection. The value feeds the label mode of 0x141f98e30 (0 normal, 1 reserved, 2 unavailable).
